messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 INCIDENT detected: gpu-pool-usw2 queue growth > 85% for 3m, preemptible eviction events spiking. Autoscaler attempts failing due to max-limit=12, backlog increasing. Runbook: preemptible-fallback-v2.

olivia-oncall: Paging SRE now — I'm oncall. Initiating bridge. @raj-sre can you pick up autoscaler logs?

raj-sre: looking. seeing a flurry of spotEvict events from cloud provider, nodes terminating. Autoscaler repeatedly fails with error 'ScaleUpFailed: quotaExceeded' from provider API.

lina-ml: Impact: embeddings and chat generation requests to us-west are seeing tail latency spikes and ~15-25% 503s reported by gateway. Customer telemetry flags high error rate for a few high-throughput tenants.

jamie-pd: creating emergency bridge: https://call.bridge/2792345678 — join if you are oncall. severity SRE-1? suggest Sev2 for now while we quantify.

olivia-oncall: joined bridge. timeline + ownership: raj = autoscaler and pool, lina = model routing/variants, cindy = customer comms.

raj-sre: paste logs:```
autoscaler: requestScaleUp target=16 current=8 reason=queue_growth
auth: provider response 403/quotaExceeded
node-controller: finalize eviction -> node-123 preempted
```

raj-sre: autoscaler config shows maxNodes=12 in region (legacy quota). There are 20 pending work items. Batching backlog grows, continuous_batched_workers are saturated.

lina-ml: quick mitigation options: 1) route some traffic to model-compact variants in eu-west (higher latency but avoids 503s), 2) fall back to dedicated pool (if available), 3) degrade real-time features for non-critical tenants.

olivia-oncall: can we flip routing? how fast? any risk of data residency issues?

lina-ml: routing change is ~2-3m to update traffic policy in routing service. no data residency for these tenants. I'll prepare policy patch.

raj-sre: I'm going to attempt temporary bump of autoscaler maxNodes to 24. Need approval from infra-cost oncall? This will spin up non-preemptible nodes (higher cost) if provider offers.

cindy-cs: I'm drafting a short note to affected customers: "We're seeing increased errors for realtime model endpoints in us-west-2 due to cloud spot interruptions. We're routing traffic and enabling fallbacks — some requests may see increased latency." Will post after we confirm routing plan.

olivia-oncall: @raj do it — prioritize availability. keep us posted on cost impact.

raj-sre: running command:```bash
kubectl -n infra autoscaler patch gpu-autoscaler-usw2 --patch '{"spec":{"maxNodes":24}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: autoscaler config patch applied (sha: ab12c3). Rolling update started.

raj-sre: autoscaler accepted new max. Cloud provider still throttling new node creation due to concurrent createLimit=6 per minute. Spinning up 4 nodes now.

lina-ml: routing policy pushed: 20% of realtime traffic -> eu-west compact model, 80% stay in us-west until capacity stable. Policy id=route-2026-03-15-01.

olivia-oncall: Monitor: queue length dropping? any change in 503 rate?

raj-sre: queue length trending down from 1200 -> 400 in 6m after routing and new nodes. 503s dropped from 22% -> 8%. Latency p95 still elevated.

lina-ml: started background KV cache priming on new nodes to reduce cold-start latency.

cindy-cs: sending update to customers now (short note, non-technical). Included ETA: monitoring and mitigation in progress.

jamie-pd: recommendation: keep bridge open until metrics stable for 30m, then do post-incident slack summary + postmortem. Raising follow-up: quota/capacity policy and preemptible fallback testing.

olivia-oncall: agreed. action items: (1) raj: open infra ticket to raise region quota and improve provider createLimit handling, (2) lina: add automated routing fallback in runbook, (3) product: consider SLO noise window.

raj-sre: opened infra ticket INFRA-4381 with logs and provider contact. linking to this thread.

olivia-oncall: If anything else urgent call pager. otherwise stand down in 40m and we'll transition to next oncall for follow-up. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT update: queue normalized to 120, 503 rate 4%, p95 latency decreasing. Incident status: mitigated — monitoring continued.

olivia-oncall: thanks team. postmortem owner: raj. tagging for follow-up: runbook updates, capacity guardrails, dedicated pool playbook.

cindy-cs: final customer note queued to send once we confirm long-term stability.

deploy-bot: bridge closed by olivia-oncall (duration 00:42:37).

olivia-oncall: I'll file the summary and start a postmortem doc. anyone add anything else here?

lina-ml: note: we should stress-test fallback routing during maintenance windows. I'll add to roadmap.

raj-sre: also propose autoscaler alert thresholds: fail if provider returns quota errors => escalate earlier.

cindy-cs: ack on comms.

jamie-pd: closing here, will wait for postmortem link. good job everyone. :clap:
